notes.title: Yokai Art 2 Demo 3.0 Released – New Maps, Bosses, and More!
notes.content:
Demo 3.0 Released – New Maps, Bosses, and More!


Hello Yokai Art players!

Our journey continues with a major content drop that expands Hiro’s story, intensifies the challenges, and prepares you for epic confrontations ahead. Here’s what awaits:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/9afb3717ab6b25850ff08d9bf6755b5de771f381.png"][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3405160/Yokai_Art_2_Tales_of_the_NineTails/"][/dynamiclink]
[hr][/hr]🗺️ New Maps & Levels
National Museum Esplanade

Levels: 3-1, 3-2

Mechanics: Thunderbolts will continuously strike the map. Keep the Lightning Rod active to absorb the lightning and protect your units.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/f0b3099b9c69ae654326b7480b44d0ed18a7ca76.gif"]

Inside the National Museum

Levels: 3-3, 3-4, 3-5

Mechanics: Protect the Guards of Embroidered Uniform and use them as frontline defenders against possessed relics.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/a05e2d6aabddfd10b0e4be803af56c20d79077ba.gif"]


[hr][/hr]

🎚️ New Features
Lily Pad  A special unit appearing in selected Ethereal Battle maps. Place it on water to create a platform for deploying other units.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/ffbb8725d1d7c71254ccdb2d2c4a8bf31079aa3d.gif"]


Kekkai – New Talent
 Kekkai can now attach to any unit, acting solely as that unit’s shield.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/da7335d0e7a0fd45c6fe90ea14f1adcd9d4cdb24.gif"]


Kyonshi Ultimate Cutscene
 Experience a brand-new cinematic when unleashing Kyonshi’s ultimate ability!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/e0a863156498eab40b6f8e742027911d5e59c205.gif"]


[hr][/hr]

👊 New Bosses
Ryuran – Human Form
 Captain of an Embroidered Uniform Squad. After discovering Hiro and his team causing chaos in her territory, she leads her squad to stop them.

Her attack unleashes a lightning chain that targets units standing on wet tiles.



 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/7cb7e721a2a50a7cdf05fc102553354e9ce89e29.gif"]

The Possessed Hairpin
 A cursed relic passed down from the Shang Dynasty, now infused with one of the Nine-Tail’s tails. It can switch possession between museum relics, controlling them to strike with relentless force.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/94f34533f17c7de7ffad74aacf88484dd9527a1c.gif"]

More surprises are in development – stay tuned!
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for your continued support. Whether you’re a strategist, explorer, or speedrunner – there’s something new for everyone. See you in the next battle! 🐉

Don’t forget to add our upcoming titles to your wishlist for the latest updates and earliest access upon release!

notes.title: Yokai Art 2 Demo 2.0 Released – New Maps, Bosses, and More!
notes.content:
Demo 2.0 Released – New Maps, Bosses, and More!

Hello Yokai Art players!   

We’re back with a major content drop that expands the world, deepens the challenges, and sets the stage for epic battles ahead. Here's what’s new:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/c758d2051055953905311a0926e71635807f1ecc.jpg"]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3405160/Yokai_Art_2_Tales_of_the_NineTails/"][/dynamiclink][hr][/hr]🗺️ New Maps & Levels
Explore brand-new regions with unique gameplay mechanics:

Jiangnan Map

Levels: 2-1, 2-2, 2-3

Features: Navigate the new Water Lane, complete with aquatic enemies and dynamic boat mechanics!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/7492981433bdaee26c7201be3f242a3b16481b80.gif"]

Television Studio Map

Levels: 2-4, 2-5

Features: Engage in tactical rescue operations with toggle-able mechanic tiles to save Cameraman hostages.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/85926d42743ba8ddc16b3a006e8665da22d7e284.gif"]
[hr][/hr]🎚️ New Map Features
We've added exciting new features to make each run more dynamic and replayable:

Difficulty Mode Selector – Choose your challenge: Chill, Normal, or Hard.

Jiangnan Enhancements – Strategic water combat and terrain navigation.

TV Studio Twists – Puzzle-like scenarios and interactive mission objectives.
[hr][/hr]👊 New Bosses
Two formidable foes have entered the battlefield:

Mouse Thug Boss 
A streetwise troublemaker who specializes in lobbing multiple firecrackers to blind and disorient your units. His unpredictable attacks and area control make positioning critical in this fast-paced encounter.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/6819731cd14b00e69fd500a8cebeae90a6bc9071.gif"]

Hone Onna Boss
A haunting bone yokai who takes the form of an eerie singing diva. Her voice empowers nearby enemies with speed buffs and culminates in devastating large-area damage, turning the battlefield into a deadly stage.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/6a7bab47947c0f7875301fc654e4c486ec968c75.gif"]
[hr][/hr]🐢 New Unit: Puppet Turtle
Role: Artillery Unit

An RNG-based Artillerist that launches indirect elemental projectiles with a small chance to massively crit. Best deployed in the backline to apply unpredictable pressure through varied elemental damage.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45572920/b183fdf11f73d05db3d508cab0980663cc5c5483.gif"]
[hr][/hr]🎮 Controller Support (Beta)
Now playable with:

Xbox controller

PS controller

Steam Deck

Enjoy the full experience from the comfort of your controller setup! Feedback welcome as we polish this feature.
[hr][/hr]🌩️ Sneak Peek: Upcoming Content
Here’s what’s coming soon:

Map 3 Expansion

Encounter the Embroidered Uniform Guard Organization during a stormy, thunderous confrontation.

Delve into the National Museum where possessed relics await your resistance.

Rogue Lite Mode Enhancements

More boons and relics to diversify your build paths.

Unlockable God Powers to shift the tide of battle.

New bosses and even tougher difficulty tiers!

More surprises are in development – stay tuned!
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for your continued support. Whether you’re a strategist, explorer, or speedrunner – there’s something new for everyone.
See you in the next battle! 🐉


Don’t forget to add our upcoming titles to your wishlist for the latest updates and earliest access upon release!

notes.title: 🎃 Event: The Crimson Witch's Midnight Masquerade 🎃
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/UxKrZlA.gif

The veil between worlds is thinning, and the midnight hour approaches once more. This year, Yokai Art brings you an all-new Halloween event: The Crimson Witch's Midnight Masquerade!

Prepare yourself for an eerie and thrilling journey through 5 new special levels, but beware—entry to these haunting grounds is only for those who have completed last year's terrifying event, The Party of the Crimson Witch. Face off against the Zombie Samurai General and discover Emily's deadly new moveset!

💀 New Event Features 💀

https://i.imgur.com/Nm2x0F4.png


 Special Samurai Zombies: Defeating them is only half the battle! After they fall, they turn into graves—but watch out, these restless spirits will rise again!
 Collect Spectre Skulls: Harvest these rare items to unlock powerful rewards, including the all-new Emily unit and two new player skills to enhance your combat prowess.


🎁 Rewards 🎁

New Unit: Emily

https://i.imgur.com/ViG2Xsl.gif

Description: Emily can attack multiple rows. Her Talent marks targets with normal attacks. Upon the marked target's death, a skull is triggered, damaging nearby enemies. Talent activation is limited to 15 charges.

2 New Hiro's skills

https://i.imgur.com/TIy12ch.png


 Cursed Pumpkins
Summon up to 2 Pumpkin Walls in the selected area to block enemies. After a short time, the pumpkins transform into Skulls that move to the right, damaging all enemies they pass through.
 Zombie Samurai
Summon a random variant of a Zombie Samurai to attack enemies while continuously moving to the right.


Don’t miss your chance to participate in this exclusive Halloween event! Unveil the dark secrets of the Crimson Witch and conquer the undead army. Will you rise to the challenge?

Join the Masquerade now and show the world your might!

Good luck, warriors. The midnight hour awaits!

Entry requirement: Completion of last year's event, "The Party of the Crimson Witch."

Get Ready: Now's the best time to explore Yokai Art with our latest update and special Fest deal. See you in the game!

notes.title: Development Update - November 2022
notes.content:
1. New Feature: Hard Mode for Yokai Art

Since most of the players had completely Normal mode, this is additional content for those who want to play more and spend time in Yokai Art. We are working on balancing the Hard Mode right now.

https://i.imgur.com/X1yF6rZ.gif

2. New Feature: Formation

As mentioned in the previous updates, since we are raising the difficulty of the game, we also want to make some additional mechanics to the gameplay (which might strongly affect the current gameplay) to let you guys have more ways of beating Yokai Art. 

Currently, we have 6 types of formation which are


 3 formations that required 1 type of element to activate - Consider Normal Tier
 3 formations that required 2 type elements to activate - Consider High Tier


https://i.imgur.com/aqF475O.png

Formation unique ability: Once you unlock formation at a certain level, an additional passive ability will be added and of course, will benefit players.

Auto-populate formation: The player can preset formation and use it directly in the battle. 

https://i.imgur.com/TxCBgTV.png
https://i.imgur.com/FidnBVw.gif

3. New Feature: Additional Raijin and Fujin Unit

We decided to push up Raijin and Fujin as units that will work differently compared with others. Raijin and Fujin will have high scaling on DPS or Special ability but can only maintain in the battle for a period of time or waves. Thus, it will limit their overpower ability of them. Also, pricing will be higher as well. 

https://i.imgur.com/Rik6N6J.gif

4. Balancing: Normal Difficulty and Strategy

As per players' feedback, our gameplay currently somehow still required players to spam units as the strategy. We are still working on it making the game more strategy-oriented, and reducing boss skill damage to prevent 1 hit killing. Hope this will help new players as well as everyone who loves Yokai Art

5. Controller Support:

We are still looking into this for future plan
